title: Your Brain When You Forget to Drink Water
description:
A headache, feeling dizzy or light-headed and feeling tired can all be symptoms of dehydration. The NHS suggests aiming for 6 to 8 cups or glasses of fluid a day, and drinking enough during the day that your pee is a pale colour. Water is a good choice; do not have drinks that are high in sugar too often.

Educational only. Not medical advice. See the NHS dehydration page for when to get help.
